contexts.text: People shall prevail over people (). To prevail over = to be higher.
Thou prevailest exceedingly over us () = on account of the Divine in them.
I have prevailed () = to overcome.
He did not prevail over him () = that he overcame in temptations.
Prevalence if they increase. Signified.
They can never prevail against the good.
That which acts interiorly prevails immensely over that which acts exteriorly. Explained.
To deliver = to prevail.
Scientific truth prevails over the power of the doctrine of falsity from evil. Explained.
That which is contrary to the Divine, prevails nothing at all. Therefore... those in falsity from evil prevail nothing at all against one who is in truth from good...
Israel prevailed () = that truth combating overcame.
Amalek prevailed () = that then falsity overcame.
Through Divine truth the Angels prevail over the Hells...
For evil would prevail, and that which prevails, overcomes; if not then, afterwards. While evil as yet prevails...
Satanic Spirits prevail through those who are in works alone; but without these, not at all...
Argumentations... through which they prevail, Signified.
And prevailed not () = that they were convicted of being in falsities and evils, and still remained in them. See AE 736.
The internal man prevails so long as...
In the other life they prevail not at all...
By the Book of Psalms he prevailed.
Occurs.
As the Hells prevail nothing against the Divine truth... nor against any man in whom it is, the Lord says the gates of Hell shall not prevail against it.
For evil Spirits prevail against those in evils... or evil through falsity, against evil through falsity, (Explained.)
Redemption. 2. Chapter Title. When the power of evil... begins to prevail over the power of good...
